items.headline: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 update
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is an update to V4.1-Flash that DeepSeek says scores higher while finishing tasks faster with shorter outputs; it reports 77.0 on DeepSWE v1.1, up from 74.2. Weights are on Hugging Face under the MIT license, and DeepSeek also opened its Search and Fetch APIs to all users.
